declared_checks: grid does not exceed analytic optimum
equilibrium_limits: No transport times, kinetics, flow, viscosity or capillary geometry.
No pH/CO2/temperature-dependent affinity, oxidation, methemoglobin, nitric oxide, or immune effects.
No dissolved oxygen, carbon dioxide transport, coagulation or immune-cell function.
Boundary pressures are imposed; no tissue-consumption or coupled circulation calculation.

parameter_provenance.P50_and_n: Sensitivity grid selected by Coda; not measured NMU-HbV or patient parameters.
parameter_provenance.capacity: Dimensionless relative binding-site inventory; no conversion to concentration, mass, infusion volume or dose.
parameter_provenance.equation: Chosen Hill-form model S(P)=P^n/(P^n+P50^n); model assumption, not fit to a named carrier.
parameter_provenance.human_trial_sources: Motivate the research track only; supply none of the numerical HC0 parameters.
parameter_provenance.pressures: Illustrative fixed boundary conditions selected by Coda; not treatment targets or measured tissue pressures.

config.question: How do hypothetical affinity and relative binding-site capacity change the equilibrium content difference between fixed loading and unloading pressures?
config.scope: Hypothetical equilibrium model; no empirical product calibration, human efficacy, tissue viability, clinical dose or manufacturing guidance.

status: Local pre-execution specification; not externally witnessed preregistration.
